description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Upgrade the application to the latest .NET LTS runtime and project format.
tasks.reason: The user requested modernization to the latest framework and Azure modernization work depends on a supported modern runtime.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the project from .NET Framework 4.8 to .NET 10 (latest LTS), including SDK-style project modernization and compatibility updates required for subsequent Azure service migrations.

tasks.description: Modernize worker messaging from RabbitMQ to Azure Service Bus.
tasks.reason: The current worker consumes messages from RabbitMQ and needs Azure-native messaging for cloud modernization.
tasks.requirements: Migrate queue connectivity and message processing from RabbitMQ to Azure Service Bus while preserving existing notification processing behavior and using managed identity authentication.

tasks.description: Modernize email notification delivery to Azure Communication Services Email.
tasks.reason: The worker currently sends email through SMTP and should use Azure-native managed email services.
tasks.requirements: Replace SMTP-based email delivery with Azure Communication Services Email while preserving notification content behavior and using managed identity authentication.

tasks.description: Scan dependencies for known CVEs and remediate vulnerabilities.
tasks.reason: Security remediation is required in every modernization plan before deployment.
tasks.requirements: Scan all project dependencies for known CVEs and remediate identified vulnerabilities. Upgrade vulnerable dependencies to minimum patched versions and validate build and tests after remediation.

tasks.description: Deploy the modernized worker to Azure Container Apps.
tasks.reason: The user requested Azure deployment for the modernized application.
tasks.requirements: Containerize and deploy the modernized worker to Azure Container Apps using managed identity and production-ready runtime configuration.
